description: LJ solid-liquid slab at coexistence densities: perfect fcc (4x4x4 cells, rho_solid = 1.0/sigma^3) below z = 6.3496; 256 liquid atoms at rho_liquid = 0.85/sigma^3 above (the z cell is asymmetric so the liquid carries its coexistence density; at rho = rho_solid a T* = 0.7 relaxation freezes epitaxially onto the perfect wall). The liquid half is RSA-placed at a 0.85 sigma hard core and relaxed by short Lennard-Jones MD at T* = 0.7 with the solid atoms frozen (engine parameters under 'md'; per-frame min pair distance, measured T* and potential energy in the frame records); the two-phase label boundary is the mid-plane of the box

potential.name: Lennard-Jones 12-6
potential.citation: Lennard-Jones potential as implemented in ASE; original: J. E. Jones, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 106, 463 (1924)

protocol.description: per frame (independent RSA + MD draw): random-sequential placement of the liquid half at a 0.85 sigma hard core (liquid-liquid and liquid-solid, minimum image), then Langevin NVT at T* = 0.7 with the solid half frozen; dt* = 0.002 for 1000 steps then dt* = 0.005 for 2000 steps (12 tau total), friction 0.5/tau. Duration measured time-resolved: liquid structure forms by ~7 tau, the first transient solid-like blips in the liquid core appear at ~17 tau
